steps.step: J1.(Q1a) each directed mark visit gamma_k has order-3 monodromy with eigenvalues {1, w, w^2}
J2.functor: T(gamma_0 then gamma_1) = T(gamma_1) T(gamma_0); T(reverse gamma_0) = T(gamma_0)^-1
J3.quarter rotation on paths: T(gamma_k+1) = U T(gamma_k) U^-1 (from i A(iz) = U A(z) U^-1)

J5.(Q1c) orbifold path relation: (M_0 U^-1)^2 = I (loop around x = infinity of x = z^4, order 2); diag M_0 = (0, -i/2, i/2) as v117
